items.ambiguous: Sponsor qualitative claim, Cavg proxy, single time point or unknown compartment/duration.
items.measurement: Quantitative, target-specific engagement with PK/free exposure and time coverage in relevant human compartments
items.non_interpretable: Unvalidated assay, interference, missing exposure or sampling information.
items.strengthens: Validated sustained engagement at tolerable achievable exposure, controls excluding surrogate-only interpretation.
items.weakens: Insufficient engagement despite adequate systemic exposure; question compound/distribution/coverage, not all ERAP1 biology.

items.ambiguous: Bulk nonspecific HLA shift, surrogate-only biomarker or discordant timing/context.
items.measurement: Paired engagement and immunopeptidomics / disease-linked antigen and CD8 PD over dose/time
items.non_interpretable: Batch effects, inadequate detection, missing paired exposure/engagement, unreliable controls.
items.strengthens: Engagement precedes reproducible expected peptide and immune changes in disease-relevant systems, with orthogonal controls.
items.weakens: Adequate sustained engagement repeatedly fails to produce prespecified PD, or PD lacks disease-linked immune effects.

items.ambiguous: Uncontrolled preliminary signal, underpowered null, multiplicity, treatment confounding or insufficient duration.
items.measurement: Predefined clinical outcomes (ASDAS/ASAS40 and MRI where applicable), effect size/uncertainty, concurrent engagement/PD, appropriate randomized controls
items.non_interpretable: Major missingness, protocol violations, unreliable endpoints or absent comparator.
items.strengthens: Credible clinically meaningful controlled improvement coherent with prior engagement/PD; reproducible effects and timing.
items.weakens: Adequate power/duration and confirmed engagement/PD repeatedly yield no meaningful controlled benefit.

items.ambiguous: Post hoc small subgroup, incomplete genotyping or confounding; retain as hypothesis.
items.measurement: Prespecified ERAP1 allotype, HLA-B27 subtype, ERAP2, substrate/tissue and disease-stage interaction analyses
items.non_interpretable: Misclassified genotype, inadequate subgroup size or incompatible assays.
items.strengthens: Reproducible biologically coherent subgroup interaction with exposure/engagement balance and multiplicity control.
items.weakens: Replicated adequately measured contexts fail to support proposed responsive subgroup; not universal failure by one subgroup.

items.ambiguous: Healthy single-dose tolerability, insufficient follow-up or poorly attributed events.
items.measurement: Dose/time matched adverse events, reversibility and sustained target coverage in patients
items.non_interpretable: Incomplete safety capture or unknown actual exposure/dose adherence.
items.strengthens: Meaningful sustained PD/engagement compatible with acceptable patient safety across relevant duration.
items.weakens: Required pharmacology cannot be maintained because of safety/tolerability; distinguish target vs compound/modality risk.
